A Straight Line Can't Map a City: SVM Kernel, Gamma and Penalty in ENVI

A straight boundary can't follow a curved cloud of city pixels. That's why the SVM default kernel bends.

Full ENVI tutorial: https://youtu.be/afo_R-sA-2I

#ENVI #RemoteSensing #MachineLearning

I'm Joseph, a geospatial scientist (PhD, Earth System Science). I explain what satellites see, in plain words. Videos: youtube.com/@Routero
